message: `aria-relevant="removals"` on the `<div>` above it sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part two elements under a wrapper written `ARIA-RELEVANT="removals"`: HTML takes the name in any case, and Firefox 158 hands the part the nearest relevance up the tree, two elements up as one (measured on 2026-10-27), as `container-relevant="removals"`; NVDA then announces none of the warning's text. A reading of the parent alone, or of the name as written, passed it; point 7 read none of it.
